parameters.description: Find deals nobody has touched since this moment (14 days ago for 'no activity in two weeks'), longest-quiet first. Replaces the created and stage dates above.

hubspot_deal_stage_reached_trigger.description: Runs when a deal enters the stage you choose in HubSpot, such as Closed won, however long ago the deal was created. A deal that leaves the stage and comes back runs it again.

output.amount: The deal's amount, a plain number such as 50000 with no currency sign, for comparing or adding up. Blank when the deal has none.
output.amount_display: The amount written as money, such as $50,000; blank when the deal has no amount. Use it in a message rather than formatting amount.
output.closedate: When it is expected to close, or closed.
output.dealstage: The ID of the stage it is in.
output.dealtype: The deal type, such as newbusiness.
output.hubspot_owner_id: The owner's ID; empty if unassigned.
output.owner_email: The owner's email address; missing when the deal has no owner. Use it to email the owner.
output.owner_name: The owner's name as HubSpot shows it; missing when the deal has no owner. Use it in a message rather than hubspot_owner_id.

parameters.description: The deal stage to watch for, such as Closed won.
parameters.name: stage

hubspot_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a contact is created in HubSpot, by a form, an import, a person or another app.

output.hs_analytics_source: Where they came from, such as ORGANIC_SEARCH.
output.lifecyclestage: Their lifecycle stage, such as lead or customer.

hubspot_new_deal_trigger.description: Runs when a deal is created in HubSpot, in any pipeline.

output.amount: The deal's amount, a plain number such as 50000 with no currency sign, for comparing or adding up. Blank when the deal has none.
output.amount_display: The amount written as money, such as $50,000; blank when the deal has no amount. Use it in a message rather than formatting amount.
output.closedate: When it is expected to close, or closed.
output.dealstage: The ID of the stage it is in.
output.dealtype: The deal type, such as newbusiness.
output.hubspot_owner_id: The owner's ID; empty if unassigned.
output.owner_email: The owner's email address; missing when the deal has no owner. Use it to email the owner.
output.owner_name: The owner's name as HubSpot shows it; missing when the deal has no owner. Use it in a message rather than hubspot_owner_id.

hubspot_new_form_submission_trigger.description: Runs when someone fills in and submits one of your HubSpot forms.

output.answers: The answers as a list of name and value pairs, in form order.
output.fields: The answers by field name, such as fields.email.
output.page_url: The page the form was submitted on.
output.submitted_at: When it was submitted, in milliseconds since 1970.

parameters.description: The form to watch. Pick it from the list, or paste the long code from the form's address in HubSpot, such as 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789.
parameters.name: form_id
